Use case: ui-mockup. Create one refined high fidelity desktop screenshot of Matt Zhang's Resources page. Attached reference is visual inspiration ONLY: charcoal serif clickable titles, subtle pale highlights, gray dates and quiet marginal annotation. Keep approved personal academic site layout: white background; centered ~1080px content at 1440px desktop width; modest top nav with 😃 Matt Zhang in Arial 20px and Blog Projects Resources Writing in compact serif at right. Small 32px serif 'Resources' heading, 19.5px regular serif body, 23px category headings, subdued 16px author on a SEPARATE SECOND LINE under each title. NO BLUE LINKS anywhere. Sidebar on left 190px with all 7 categories: College study; Grad school (general); CS PhD; Great work; AI; Cold emails; Finding a job. Subtle active marker only, no pill buttons. Main section 'Undergrad/College Study' with rows 'Doing well in your courses' author 'Andrej Karpathy'; 'Exam study guide' author 'Josh Hug · Berkeley CS61B'; 'How to get good grades in Computer Science' author 'Reddit · r/csMajors'; 'How to Make the Most of Your Professor’s Office Hours' author 'University of South Florida'; 'College tips, tricks and hacks' author 'Matt Might'. Follow by 'Grad School (General)' and 'HOWTO: Get into grad school for STEM' author 'Matt Might'. Hairline separators, compact 14px vertical row padding. Clickable titles charcoal #303030 regular serif, no bright colors. Show hover on FIRST title with small arrow cursor and an elegant small note reveal. Do NOT add repeated 'Why I recommend' controls to every row. Footnote small gray at bottom 'Illustrative dates and notes.' Date data MUST be explicitly placeholders: first row 'Published: YYYY-MM-DD', other rows 'Published: YYYY' or 'Date unknown'. If added date shown, 'Added: YYYY-MM-DD'. Never invent numeric publication dates. Hover note sample copy: heading 'Why I recommend it', text 'A helpful starting point for building better study habits. Read with your own course and goals in mind.' Dates always persist even with note hidden. No rating badges, no stale/outdated warnings determined by age. No device or browser frames.

Avoid covering the second row title; place tooltip toward right side of first row. All gray/black only. Include small gray top helper 'Hover or focus a title for my notes.'
